metadataRaw.title: How to Instantly Relieve Shin Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly fix shin pain.

A major cause of shin pain (including shin splints) is due to repetitive stress and injury on the muscles and tendons that support this area. This includes the tibialis anterior muscle.

Over time, this leads to a blend of weakness and tightness and (eventually) pain.

To fix this, we'll go over 3 different methods to help release muscle tightness, stretch, and strengthen these muscles for both quick and long-lasting shin pain relief.

To get the best results, go through all the exercises and use what gives the most relief.

Watch now and instantly fix shin pain at home!
